en: The image shows a historical, ornate building set within a garden or park, surrounded by people in period attire suggesting a scene from the late 19th or early 20th century. The building displays classic Central European architectural elements, and the sign 'Cafe Kaiserpark' is visible. The text at the top reads 'Karlsbad. Cafe Kaiserpark.' Additional text on the right margin indicates the publisher: '8964 Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
